description.value: It's a pirate's, or at least a vagabond's, life for you. You've learned the value of a first impression and worked hard to cultivate your opening pitch. The fact that you can hold two conversations at once certainly helps, especially when meeting groups. You're trained in Diplomacy and gain the Group Impression skill feat. If you would already be trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example) you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
